inference: 16 prespecified two-sided paired Monte Carlo tests; Holm family; history-level bootstrap
inference_assumptions: Paired sign-flips assume symmetric/exchangeable history differences, not randomized treatment assignment; percentile bootstrap family intervals are approximate.
guard_scope: Pooled REV COMMON/day and MIXED/day only; other cases and load/age strata are descriptive, not a whole-learner safety acceptance.
limits: Global common-min tests only the lower matched budget, not dose-only sufficiency at high dose.
Route-shared controls remove unmatched route/sign mass; inspect retained coverage.
Frozen source replay is not an autonomous recovered-adaptation learner.
Synthetic cues and inherited EVENT kernel do not establish fly physiology or a persistent core.
